claim: Test whether prompt-dependent tolerance to acceleration mechanisms and budgets can support stable prompt-only selection. This asset-only spatial screening does not establish learnability or VBench failure.
limitations: A 33-frame prefix screening of four preselected prompts and two seeds, not a complete-video benchmark or router training set.
B025 denotes main-generation spatial pixel density, not end-to-end runtime budget.
Native LR and FULL follow different trajectories. Composition differences alone are not quality failures; FULL can also violate the prompt.
Low-resolution generation + FlashVSR v1.1 Tiny x4 + Lanczos resize is our composite spatial baseline, not an official acceleration reproduction.
MP4 previews are lossy; VBench and humans receive the same existing MP4 bytes. No cross-trajectory pixel reconstruction score.
Seven separate custom-input VBench dimensions, NOT the official full VBench total. No invented composite quality score.
Restoration-only latency cannot establish pipeline speedup. No end-to-end speedup is reported.
